title: “He anointed your 9-to-5 and made it 24-karat purpose.”
paragraphs: “He anointed your 9-to-5 and made it 24-karat purpose.”

1 Samuel 16:13 (NIV)
“So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of his brothers, and from that day on the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon David.”
The moment of anointing transformed an unnoticed shepherd into an inevitable king.
